purpose: Finish the six missing model identities without changing spawns, combat, loot or progression.
style: Soft stylized Thai fantasy, broad hand-painted colours, readable from the 2.5D game camera; no gore or noisy microdetail.

credits.correctionReason: First kongkoi reconstruction had an unwanted second leg visible from the side; rejected before rigging.

assets.design: Violet bark goblin, one central leg by design, two arms, broad rounded mask face, ochre loincloth. One-legged anatomy is intentional, never a broken two-legged human.
assets.motion: Planted idle, one-foot hop, short arm swipe, recoil and seated settle.

assets.design: Olive water monitor, long tapered tail, four sprawled articulated limbs and five short clawed toes per foot; broad reptile muzzle, no mammal ears.
assets.motion: Low four-legged walk, restrained breathing, head lunge, recoil and grounded crouch.

assets.design: Pale jade drowned-forest spirit, rounded mask face, two arms and one continuous reed-and-water robe hem; no human feet.
assets.motion: Hover, glide, two-arm reach, recoil and forward settle.

assets.design: Golden flame seed with one mask face and a single tapered flame tail; compact opaque solid sculpt, no disconnected particles or limbs.
assets.motion: Gentle hovering, trailing tail, forward casting pulse, recoil and dimmed settle.

assets.design: Desaturated blue hooded wanderer with rounded ivory mask, two arms and opaque tapering cloth hem, restrained indigo Thai cloth trim.
assets.motion: Hover, glide, reaching strike, recoil and bowed settle.

assets.role: stationary map boss with root pull
assets.design: Tall female teak-tree guardian, rounded human-like face, dark flowing hair, moss-green Thai draped costume, two arms and continuous rooted lower body; attached broad leaf crown and roots.
assets.motion: Rooted idle, unused restrained walk fallback, deliberate reaching curse, recoil and bowed root-bound death.

limitations: No separately articulated fingers, jaws or facial animation
